summary: Discover AWS-hosted AI agent and MCP-relevant assets from the operator's environment, emit canonical agent-bom inventory JSON, and scan it without giving agent-bom long-lived cloud credentials. Use when a user asks to inventory AWS Bedrock, ECS, SageMaker, Lambda, EKS, Step Functions, EC2, or agentic AWS infrastructure as canonical inventory. Passing that inventory to agent-bom is optional and operator-chosen.
